0.11.7 is a patch of 0.11 and interoperates with 0.11.0 through 0.11.6: format epoch 7, backup format 5, protocol line `11` and every storage, wire and protocol format are unchanged, and the server, the gateway and `ursulactl` change only their version. Nodes, gateways and extensions of 0.11.0 through 0.11.7 run in one cluster and open, read and import the same streams. Upgrade a cluster in place with an ordinary rolling restart (`helm upgrade`), and the SQLite client by installing `@tonbo/sqlite-ursula` 0.11.7. Rolling back to any earlier 0.11 release is safe; a values file that sets `governance.coldHealth` needs the 0.11.7 chart, so remove it before rolling the chart back.

- **The chart can set the cold-health gate.** The new `governance.coldHealth` values (`hotSizeHigh`, `hotSizeLow`, `intervalMs`, `unhealthyTicks`, `healTicks`) render `[governance.cold_health]` only when set, so a values file without them renders the same config as before. Ursula requires `hot_size_high` (48 MiB by default) to be below `storage.cold.max_hot_size_per_group`, so with the 0.11.6 chart any `coldStorage.flush.maxHotBytesPerGroup` of 48 MiB or less made every voter refuse its config at start. Set `hotSizeHigh` and `hotSizeLow` below the ceiling instead, for example 24 MiB and 16 MiB at 32 MiB. The chart now checks the server's watermark rules when it renders, an unset watermark at the server default: `hotSizeLow` < `hotSizeHigh`, and with cold storage enabled `coldStorage.flush.minHotBytes` < `hotSizeHigh` < a non-zero `maxHotBytesPerGroup`. A config the server would refuse fails at `helm template` instead of at voter start (#955).
- **A lapsed open says to open again.** A path that `ursula_open` handed out and that no connection opened within a minute is retired, and a later open of it fails with `SQLITE_CANTOPEN`. `ursula_classify` used to return `null` for that failure, so a host could not tell it from a missing file. It now returns `not_bound` with action `retry` and a message that says to call `ursula_open` again. `@tonbo/sqlite-ursula` and `sqlite-ursula` throw `UrsulaSetupError` (`not_bound`, `retry`) for it. Every other failure classifies as before.

Known issues: the known issues of 0.11.0 are unchanged. Every change is listed in the [0.11.7 release notes](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/release-notes#0117).
